messages:
maria a. (AE): Quick heads-up — FinServe wants a short POC next week. Requirements: BYOK with HSM-backed keys, proof of attestation, 30-day rotation asked in their security questionnaire, plus pricing clarity. Can SE/ops confirm feasibility and any blockers?
jamal r. (SE): We can run a BYOK flow. Two common patterns: customer KMS (CloudHSM) access via secure peering OR a PKCS#11 proxy for on-prem HSM. Needs network whitelisting + a pre-signed key import handshake.
tanya (solutions): POC checklist I use: attestation doc, network allowlist, SOW template, runbook for key handoff, and a rollback plan. I'll drop the template link: https://redwood.example/poc-templates (internal).
olivia (sales-eng): Pricing question — do we treat this as a free eval or bill as short Dedicated trial? Sales leans to free hosted credits + PS for integration. Recommend a one-off PS line for key integration.
satoshi (crypto-ops): Crypto notes: rotating keys every 30 days during a live POC is risky. For the POC keep a static key for the test window, then demonstrate rotation in a cutover rehearsal. If customer insists on live rotation we support dual-key rollover (signer -> rewrap) but it requires extra orchestration and a short outage for rewrap unless using KV cache invalidation. Example minimal PKCS#11 proxy config for handshake:```
proxy: 
  listener: 0.0.0.0:12345
  tls: true
  hsm_provider: pkcs11
  slot_label: "FIN-HSM-1"
  allowlist_ips: ["198.51.100.12/32"]
```
jamal r. (SE): Also note HSM attestation: we can accept vendor-signed attestation PDFs (CloudHSM, Thales) or an attestation API call. FIPS 140-2 Level 3 is vendor/product-dependent — we support HSMs that are L2/L3 but need customer's HSM model to confirm.
deploy-bot: Checklist created: k8s secrets mount, KMS-binding role, network egress rules, attestation upload endpoint, SRE on-call for the key-handover window. Link: https://redwood.example/ops/checklists/2456789012
legal (CPL): From compliance: we need the customer's signed KMS policy addendum and evidence of attestation. Also confirm data residency region and whether Redwood hosts key material (we prefer customer-managed).
maria a. (AE): Customer also flagged HSM FIPS 140-2 L3 requirement + proof of rotation every 30 days. @satoshi is L3 + 30d doable for POC, or do we push to post-POC cutover?
satoshi (crypto-ops): L3 is doable if their HSM vendor certifies it — confirm model. 30d rotation during POC = operational overhead; recommend we commit to demonstrating rotation as part of the cutover runbook rather than during the short POC. If they insist, propose staged rollout: 
- Day 0: import key (static)
- Day 3: demonstrate automated rollover in staging with no production traffic
I'll prepare a short doc on dual-key rollover steps.
olivia (sales-eng): Proposal for customer: 7-day POC (hosted credits), PS fee $4k for key handshake + attestations, roll to Dedicated with reserved capacity afterwards. @maria can you confirm if we can flag that offer?
maria a. (AE): I will confirm 7 days + PS line with FinServe today. Also asking if they can accept rotation demonstrated in cutover instead of 30d live rotation. Will update here once they respond. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
